name: tr_podz
caption:
IF PODZ WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🐣 Ducklett, the ugly duckling: 1.4 points a game as a college freshman
🦢 Swanna, the glow-up: WCC co-Player of the Year at Santa Clara
🐾 Eevee, the rookie: pick #19, All-Rookie First Team
🛡️ Registeel, the iron man: all 82 games last season
🔥 Blaziken, the heater: career-high 30 against Sacramento
🦊 Zoroark, the ace: 15.8 points, 5.4 rebounds, 4.3 assists through 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Podziemski: 16 games off the bench as an Illinois freshman, 1.4 points per game; transferred to Santa Clara, WCC co-Player of the Year (2023); drafted 19th overall in 2023 by Golden State; NBA All-Rookie First (1st) Team (2024); April 10, 2026: career-high 30 points vs Sacramento; appeared in all 82 games in 2025-26
